lines.text: At the icy stretch, Theo pulls on new slip-on traction for the first time.
Two steps later, it twists off his heel.
Here's the fix. Fit traction on your own boots at home,
with the heel strap pulled fully over the heel.
Carry it where you can reach it.
On steep or hard ice, use proper microspikes, or turn back.
Save this before your next icy hike.
